releaseNotes: Fix Submitted Task White Screen: Defensive parsing for task orders, safe date formatting, and guarded image rendering prevent white screens on the completed/history tasks page
App-Wide ErrorBoundary: Wrap all mobile screens in a graceful error boundary with a reload button so unexpected exceptions never cause blank screens
Live HQ Inventory Stock Visibility: Medical Representatives can view real-time depot stock indicators directly on product chips and order forms
Dual Out-of-Stock Notification System: When an order contains low or depleted stock at the HQ depot, both the MR and Headquarter Admin receive immediate alert notifications for rapid replenishment
Seamless In-Place Update: Release signing ensures smooth APK update without uninstalling or losing device credentials
